description: This file defines React components and functions for rendering and managing a console tab in a trace viewer, including handling console entries, formatting messages, and rendering UI elements.

methods.name: useConsoleTabModel
methods.description: React hook that creates and filters console entries based on the trace model and selected time boundaries.

methods.name: ConsoleTab
methods.description: React functional component that renders the console tab UI, including console entries with formatting and icons.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats console message arguments into JSX elements, supporting printf-style formatting.

methods.name: formatAnsi
methods.description: Converts ANSI text to HTML elements for rendering.

methods.name: parseCSSStyle
methods.description: Parses CSS style string into a style object for inline styling.

methods.name: supportProperty
methods.description: Checks if a CSS property is supported for styling.
